title: Investigations on Financial Institutions for Breaching Car Loan Restrictions
what_it_is: Investigations on Financial Institutions for Breaching Car Loan Restrictions

sections.label: MAS motor vehicle loan checks
sections.summary: FIs regulated by MAS must ascertain the reasonableness of stated motor vehicle purchase prices in loan applications.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Financial institutions (FIs) regulated by the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) are required to ascertain the reasonableness of the stated purchase prices of motor vehicles quoted in loan applications.

sections.label: No MAS action since 2013
sections.summary: Since motor financing rules were reintroduced in 2013, MAS has taken no regulatory actions against FIs, so no tightening is immediately needed.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Since the motor financing rules were reintroduced in 2013, MAS has not had to take any regulatory actions against FIs.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: There is, hence, also no immediate need to tighten the regulations.

sections.label: Hire-purchase financing restrictions applied
sections.summary: MAS is aware of hire-purchase loans not in line with motor vehicle financing restrictions, so the same restrictions now apply to hire-purchase regulations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: MAS is aware that for hire-purchase arrangements, there have been loans given out that are not in line with the motor vehicle financing restrictions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: Therefore, the same restrictions are now applied to the hire-purchase regulations.

sections.label: Private-hire vehicles as businesses
sections.summary: Private-hire vehicles are businesses that hire vehicles to rent out or run as Uber services, and are not really caught by this policy because it is revenue-generating.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: Private-hire vehicles are businesses, so they hire vehicles to rent out or run as Uber services.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: They are not really caught 	Page: 43 by this policy, because it is revenue-generating.

sections.label: TDSR inclusion question
sections.summary: On the third question, whether this would be part of TDSR, the speaker believes it is.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: As for the third question, whether this would be part of TDSR, I believe it is.
